nodes.summary: The steady-state (DC) gain `d - c ⬝ A⁻¹ b`; for nonsingular `A` the output at the equilibrium for input `u` is `dcGain * u`.
nodes.title: Steady-state (DC) gain of a linear system

nodes.summary: For nonsingular `A`, the unique equilibrium for input `u` is `x = -u • A⁻¹ b`.
nodes.title: Unique equilibrium of a nonsingular linear system

nodes.summary: The vector field `A x + u b` at state `x` and input `u`.
nodes.title: Vector field of a linear time-invariant system

nodes.summary: Along a trajectory `ẋ(t) = A x(t) + u(t) b`, the functional `k ⬝ x(t)` of an integral-feedback system has derivative `y(t) = c ⬝ x(t) + d u(t)`: it is the time integral of the output.
nodes.title: Integral-feedback functional is the time integral of the output

nodes.summary: Integral feedback is necessary (linear systems with nonsingular `A`): perfect adaptation holds iff some linear functional of the state integrates the output; one such functional is `k = c A⁻¹`.
nodes.title: Integral feedback is necessary

nodes.summary: A linear functional `z = k ⬝ x` of the state integrates the output, `ż = k ⬝ (A x + u b) = y`, for every state and input.
nodes.title: Integral feedback

nodes.summary: For nonsingular `A`, perfect adaptation holds iff the steady-state gain vanishes.
nodes.title: Perfect adaptation iff the DC gain vanishes

nodes.summary: For every constant input `u`, the output vanishes at every equilibrium.
nodes.title: Perfect adaptation

nodes.summary: A single-input single-output linear time-invariant system `ẋ = A x + u b`, `y = c ⬝ x + d u` with state space `n → ℝ`.
nodes.title: Single-input single-output linear time-invariant system

nodes.summary: Integral feedback gives robust perfect adaptation (nonlinear form). Let `F p` be the vector field and `y p` the output of a system with parameters `p`, and let `z` be a differentiable state function with derivative `z' x` satisfying `z' x (F p x) = y p x` for all `p`, `x` (so `ż = y` along every trajectory, for every parameter). Then the output vanishes at every equilibrium of every `F p`.
nodes.title: Integral feedback gives robust perfect adaptation

nodes.summary: For nonsingular `A`, the output at the equilibrium for input `u` is `dcGain * u`.
nodes.title: Output at equilibrium equals DC gain times input

nodes.summary: The output `c ⬝ x + d u`, measured from its adapted value.
nodes.title: Output of a linear time-invariant system

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
